newsitem.title: USA: Weirton hot strip mill fully operational.
newsitem.headline: Weirton hot strip mill fully operational.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp's hot strip mill resumed operations on Thursday after an electrical short circuit idled the steel slab rolling facility on January 31, the company said.
Weirton said company officials expected the outage, coupled with minor disruptions within primary operations, to "adversely impact" first-quarter operating income by $5 million.
It said it planned to mitigate the impact by scheduling one additional turn per week.
The short circuit halted a 7,000-horsepower motor that drives the hot strip mill's reversing rougher, it added.
